title: Evaluating Tetrahydrocannabinol as an Adjunct to Opioid Agonist Therapy
official: Evaluating Tetrahydrocannabinol as an Adjunct to Opioid Agonist Therapy for Individuals Living With Opioid Use Disorder: A Phase II, Placebo-controlled, Blinded, Pilot Study to Assess Safety and Feasibility (THC-MMT)
summary: This pilot study will evaluate the feasibility and safety of using 1:1 tetrahydrocannabinol (THC):Cannabidiol (CBD) cannabis oil as an adjunct therapy to methadone-based Opioid Agonist Therapy (OAT) for individuals with opioid use disorder (OUD) in a community setting.

sites.f: Rapid Access Addiction Clinic (RAAC), St. Paul's Hospital
